facts.value: Alignment must be found: msg.payload.alignment?.predictions?.[0]?.success === true, otherwise alignmentFound is false and the part fails ('Alignment not found')

facts.subject: io_logic
facts.value: Segmentation passes only if no blob exceeds the pixel threshold: blobs.filter(b => (b.pixel_count || 0) > PIXEL_THRESHOLD); segPass = failingBlobs.length === 0

facts.subject: io_logic
facts.value: Classification passes only if every predicted_class starts with 'pass' (trimmed, lower-cased): return !predictedClass.startsWith('pass'); classPass = failingClassifications.length === 0

facts.subject: io_logic
facts.value: Overall verdict is the AND of all three checks: const pass = !(segPass === false || classPass === false || alignmentFound === false)

facts.subject: io_logic
facts.value: payload: Buffer.from([pass ? 1 : 0]) — single byte, 1 = PASS, 0 = FAIL
